issues.issue: Regression in the pending, unexported script: mako_lib.bake_clean applies the hardened-normal Bevel, then edits topology (dissolve_degenerate, dissolve_verts, triangulate, rotate_edges). Custom normals and sharp edges are lost, so the lower, magwell, trigger guard, upper flank, precision cheek and FA cap end come out 'melted', with smooth gradients across hard edges. Re-running the build as-is would publish worse shading than the current exports.

issues.fix: Remove degenerate triangles before beveling: run the cleanup on the boolean result inside L.finish, right after L.clean and before the Bevel modifier is added. Alternatively, after bake_clean: clear custom split normals, me.set_sharp_from_angle(radians(30)), then add and apply a WeightedNormal modifier (FACE_AREA, keep_sharp=True). Without normal maps, zero-area tris are harmless in Bevy, so dropping bake_clean entirely is acceptable. Check a clay close-up of the lower at the cu_receiver_plusX angle before exporting.

verdict:
Not yet acceptable. It is close, and most of the fix already exists in the unexported script. The delivered GLBs are technically clean: sockets are correct and unrotated, glTF/FBX validity is good, there is no emissive, all 12 shared attachments fit with 0 mm penetration, and mags drop cleanly. The gun meets every hard user decision (no sights, no counter, long squared 3-row handguard, birdcage, graphite/bone split, mag window with cartridges) and reads as an M4 at 64 px. Blocking problems:

1. The folder is half-updated by an interrupted fix pass. sockets.json disagrees with every exported GLB/FBX by 8 mm on Under/LeftHand, tri_counts.json and textures/ match nothing, and the validation step is non-fatal.
2. The charging handle sits inside the castle nut and tube and clips through its whole pull.
3. The pending script fixes that and several art notes (drum smiley, pill slots, stipple colour, per-round mag-check nodes, safe stock travel), but its new bake_clean step melts the shading on the lower, magwell and trigger guard. Exporting it as-is would be a regression.

Fix order: repair bake_clean (normals), run the full build once so every output comes from one run, and make check_glb fatal. Then address the art gaps against v09: player-facing receiver detail, the precision cheek riser that still floats, and grip/mag chunkiness.
